name: Sea Sandwort
desc: Sea Sandwort (Honckenya peploides): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Honckenya peploides, the sea sandwort (UK) or seaside sandplant (Canada), is the only species in the genus Honckenya of the plant family Caryophyllaceae.
